note: Météo-France publishes the forest fire danger from June to September (about 17:00 local time); out of this season there is no map and no level is given. It is a danger of the department as a whole, in four levels, for the two days after the publication: not a warning, not a fire detected (see `fires_nearby` of `GET /v1/point`), and the local conditions of a forest can differ.
